asXii layers panel: 5 options

Five takes on a cleaned-up Layers panel, each at the right pane's real width (250px) and in the app's colors. They all work: click a layer to make it active, click the eye to show / hide it (Alt-click: show only that one, like Photoshop), double-click the name to rename it, and drag a layer up or down to reorder it. The buttons and menus do what they say on this sample stack. Numbered so you can point at one ("L3, but with L1's footer").

Drag and drop replaces the ▲ ▼ buttons; the text buttons become icons with tooltips. Nothing here is wired into the editor yet.
